title: Breaking the Cloak! Unveiling Chinese Cloaked Toxicity with Homophone Graph and Toxic Lexicon
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical detection of cloaked toxic language (abusive language, discrimination) for content moderation. While toxicity detection is an aspect of AI safety, the paper does not specifically evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, moral philosophies, or ethical systems; it is a technical contribution to NLP rather than an ethics-focused study.
